title: Why he loves clarinet over tenor
summary: The clarinet revival in Europe, his dissatisfaction with tenor, and love of trumpet and clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Yeah, that's right. If you went to Samoa, you'd get shit in some way. That's right. But I'm really glad to be here. You were in on this revival of New Orleans music in Europe then. That's when you started going back to clarinet, right? When the revival came? That's right. Yeah.
But I had already started clarinet. Yeah. I was really...
But I mean, you emphasizing it in your role as a musician.
Yes.
Along about that time.

Well, you see, I always wanted to like clarinet because I knew clarinet is just like a cancer, it never dies. You know, you never get rid of the cancer, hardly. Yeah. And clarinet is a... I like the tone of it. Yeah.
Well, you loved violin when you were a kid, and there's something similar about that.
Yes. And I always didn't want to save clarinet. You know, you see, I played tenor, and they said I could play, too.
Yeah.
And I had compliments like guys from guys like Coleman Hawkins, Benny Collard, Donnie Polo, which is not known here.
Yeah.

But I know he's an able man because he's a very good musician and a very good swain man. And so, but I never felt satisfied playing tenor. There's two instruments that I like to play, trumpet and clarinet.
Well, you know, bunk set, it just goes upstairs and downstairs. Yes. You know where to go. That's right. Yeah. And I like trumpets.
All right.

You know, I think there's something psychological about it. On clarinet, the tone is so beautiful and satisfying. You can play the same thing on a saxophone, it doesn't satisfy you. No. The clarinet gives you everything you want. Yes. But the sax, you can play your ass off on it. It just doesn't...

It doesn't stimulate me at all. And I hear somebody else, me and me, you know, I like them. I like the way they play, like Don Byers, Colvin Hawkins, Tex Bennett, who's really mentioned him, and many others that really jam up on that instrument.
Yeah.
But I never felt at home playing it.
Yeah.

I never... One time that I don't remember that I've played tenor on a session or even on a job and being satisfied. You know, there always was something missing that I couldn't... I just couldn't do it. No, I had a lot of good words about me playing tenor, but me personally, that was satisfying. But clarinet is an instrument I love to play. It's something about it. I don't know if it's the extension of the instrument or if it's the sound. I know it's difficult to play.
Yeah.
And I love clarinet.
